title.en: OpenAI Dots Launch Faces xAI Trolling and Meta Muse Security Questions
title.zh-TW: OpenAI（OpenAI）Dots 推出遭遇 xAI（xAI）嘲諷及 Meta（Meta）Muse 安全疑慮

summary.en: OpenAI launched Dots as always-on AI agents connecting to apps for multistep tasks and positioned as answer to Meta’s Muse. xAI acquired dot.com redirecting to Grok. Meta’s Muse faces a zero-day vulnerability allowing local apps control despite privacy claims, with Amazon blocking it.
summary.zh-TW: OpenAI（OpenAI）推出 Dots 作為永遠在線 AI 代理，可連接應用程式處理多步驟任務，並定位為 Meta（Meta）Muse 的回應。xAI（xAI）取得 dot.com 並導向 Grok。Meta（Meta）Muse 面臨零時差漏洞，允許本地應用程式控制，儘管有隱私宣稱，Amazon（Amazon）已封鎖它。

body.en: Lede: OpenAI introduced its Dots always-on AI agents designed to connect to apps and handle multistep tasks, presented as its answer to Meta’s Muse. What happened: Before the Tuesday launch of Dots, xAI acquired the domain dot.com which now redirects to the Grok chatbot download page. Separately, Meta introduced Muse a few weeks ago as an assistant that books appointments, fills out forms and handles customer tasks, with claims it is built from the ground up for privacy and security. A zero-day vulnerability was reported that gives locally run apps and terminal commands complete control of the agent. Amazon began blocking Muse from its site on Sunday. Why it matters: The Dots launch highlights competition in proactive AI agents while the reported xAI domain move and Muse security issue draw attention to industry responses and vulnerabilities in new AI tools. Sources agree/disagree: TechCrunch, Wired AI and Ars Technica report on the respective launches and issues without conflicting details on the described events. Still uncertain: No further details on the extent of the Muse vulnerability or any responses from Meta are provided in the sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：OpenAI（OpenAI）推出 Dots 永遠在線 AI 代理，設計用於連接應用程式並處理多步驟任務，定位為 Meta（Meta）Muse 的回應。 事件經過：Dots 週二推出前，xAI（xAI）已取得 dot.com 網域名稱，現導向 Grok 聊天機器人下載頁面。Meta（Meta）數週前推出 Muse 作為助理，可預約、填表並處理客戶任務，並宣稱從頭建置以確保隱私與安全。報導指出存在零時差漏洞，讓本地應用程式與終端指令完全控制該代理。Amazon（Amazon）週日開始在網站封鎖 Muse。 重要性：Dots 推出凸顯主動式 AI 代理的競爭，而 xAI（xAI）網域動作與 Muse 安全問題引發對新 AI 工具回應與漏洞的關注。 來源一致與分歧：TechCrunch、Wired AI 與 Ars Technica 分別報導相關推出與問題，所述事件無衝突細節。 仍未確定：來源未提供 Muse 漏洞範圍或 Meta（Meta）回應的進一步細節。

title.en: Donald Trump Orders US Government to Call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
title.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）下令美國政府將AI稱為「Super Intelligence」

summary.en: President Donald Trump signed an executive order directing the US executive branch to replace references to artificial intelligence with Super Intelligence in official documents and websites. CNBC reports this occurs as polls indicate sinking support on the issue ahead of midterms, with Trump shrugging off concerns about AI and data centers impacting Republicans.
summary.zh-TW: 唐納·川普（Donald Trump）總統簽署行政命令，要求美國行政部門在官方文件與網站中以Super Intelligence取代人工智慧相關用語。CNBC報導，此舉發生在民調顯示其在該議題支持度下滑、可能影響共和黨期中選舉之際，川普對AI與資料中心議題是否傷及共和黨表示無所謂。

body.en: Lede: President Donald Trump has directed the US government to stop using the term artificial intelligence in favor of Super Intelligence. What happened: The Verge reports that a new executive order requires official policy websites, documents, and press releases to refer only to Super Intelligence. Trump stated at an event for America.gov that the word super is the best and simplest. CNBC notes Trump shrugged when asked about polls showing sinking support on the AI issue and potential harm to Republicans in midterms from backing AI and data centers. Why it matters: The change affects how the executive branch communicates on technology policy, aligning with Trump's preference for the term Super Intelligence. Sources agree/disagree: Both sources confirm the executive order and terminology shift. CNBC adds details on polls and midterms while The Verge provides the quote and scope of the order. Still uncertain: Details on implementation across agencies and exact poll numbers are not specified in the provided sources.
body.zh-TW: 導言：唐納·川普（Donald Trump）總統已指示美國政府停止使用人工智慧一詞，改用Super Intelligence。 事件經過：The Verge報導，一項新行政命令要求官方政策網站、文件與新聞稿僅使用Super Intelligence。川普在America.gov活動中表示，super是最好且最簡單的詞。CNBC指出，川普在被問及民調顯示AI議題支持度下滑、可能影響共和黨期中選舉時聳肩回應。 重要性：此變更影響行政部門科技政策溝通方式，符合川普對Super Intelligence用語的偏好。 來源一致與分歧：兩來源均確認行政命令與用語轉變。CNBC補充民調與期中選舉細節，The Verge則提供引言與命令範圍。 仍未確定：各機關執行細節與確切民調數字在來源中未提及。

title.en: Chaeyoung and Zion.T Face Conflicting Breakup Reports After JYP Exit
title.zh-TW: 彩瑛（Chaeyoung）與Zion.T（Zion.T）傳分手 JYP（JYP）離開後公司發聲

summary.en: Reports emerged claiming Chaeyoung split from Zion.T following her JYP departure announcement, with agencies threatening legal action. A follow-up report states both sides deny the breakup and affirm they remain in a relationship.
summary.zh-TW: 彩瑛（Chaeyoung）宣布離開JYP（JYP）後，傳出與Zion.T（Zion.T）分手消息，雙方公司揚言提告。後續報導指出公司澄清仍在交往。

body.en:
Lede: Entertainment outlets reported conflicting accounts regarding the relationship status of Chaeyoung and Zion.T shortly after her announcement of leaving JYP.
What happened: One report stated that Chaeyoung and Zion.T had broken up, prompting swift statements from both agencies threatening lawsuits. A second report indicated the pair denied any split, attributing rumors to busy schedules and confirming they are still dating.
Why it matters: Celebrity relationship rumors in the K-pop and music industry often draw significant fan and media attention, especially when tied to agency changes.
Sources agree/disagree: Outlets differ on whether a breakup occurred, with one highlighting legal threats and the other emphasizing ongoing romance.
Still uncertain: The exact nature of any statements from the individuals involved remains unconfirmed beyond agency comments.
Sources: TVBS, ETtoday.

導言：彩瑛（Chaeyoung）宣布離開JYP（JYP）後不久，娛樂媒體對其與Zion.T（Zion.T）的關係狀態出現相互矛盾的報導。
事件經過：一則報導指出彩瑛（Chaeyoung）與Zion.T（Zion.T）已分手，促使雙方經紀公司迅速發表聲明揚言提告。另一則報導則表示雙方否認分手，歸因於行程繁忙而疏遠，並確認仍維持交往。
重要性：K-pop與音樂圈名人感情傳聞常引發粉絲與媒體關注，尤其涉及經紀公司變動時。
來源異同：媒體在是否已分手一事上看法分歧，一方強調法律行動，另一方則強調持續交往。
尚未確定：當事人本人除經紀公司聲明外，確切回應仍未明朗。
來源：TVBS、ETtoday。

title.en: Caleb Flynn Found Guilty of Murdering Wife Ashley in American Idol Trial
title.zh-TW: 凱萊布·弗林（Caleb Flynn）在美國偶像（American Idol）前參賽者妻子艾希莉（Ashley）謀殺案審判中被判有罪

summary.en: Former American Idol contestant Caleb Flynn was found guilty of murdering his wife Ashley in their Ohio home. His mistress Alleigha Botner testified against him during the trial that ended with a guilty verdict on September 29, 2026.
summary.zh-TW: 前美國偶像（American Idol）參賽者凱萊布·弗林（Caleb Flynn）被判在俄亥俄州家中謀殺妻子艾希莉（Ashley）。其情婦艾莉亞·博特納（Alleigha Botner）在審判中作證，陪審團於2026年9月29日做出有罪判決。

body.en: Lede: Former American Idol contestant Caleb Flynn has been convicted of murdering his wife Ashley. What happened: Caleb Flynn was found guilty of shooting his wife inside their Ohio home. He had told his mistress he wanted her dead and attempted to blame the murder on a break-in. The jury reached its verdict on September 29, 2026. Alleigha Botner, the woman who had an affair with Flynn, testified against him. Why it matters: The case involves a former American Idol season 12 contestant now facing life in prison without parole after being convicted of killing his wife. Sources agree/disagree: All sources confirm the guilty verdict against Caleb Flynn for murdering his wife Ashley, with mention of mistress Alleigha Botner testifying. Still uncertain: Limited details are available about Flynn's family or parents following the conviction.
body.zh-TW: 導言：前美國偶像（American Idol）參賽者凱萊布·弗林（Caleb Flynn）已被判謀殺妻子艾希莉（Ashley）罪名成立。 事件經過：凱萊布·弗林（Caleb Flynn）被判在俄亥俄州家中槍殺妻子。他曾告訴情婦希望她死去，並試圖將謀殺歸咎於入室盜竊。陪審團於2026年9月29日做出判決。與弗林有染的女子艾莉亞·博特納（Alleigha Botner）在庭上作證指控他。 事件意義：此案涉及前美國偶像（American Idol）第12季參賽者，現因殺害妻子被判無假釋可能之終身監禁。 來源一致與分歧：所有來源均確認凱萊布·弗林（Caleb Flynn）謀殺妻子艾希莉（Ashley）罪名成立，並提及情婦艾莉亞·博特納（Alleigha Botner）作證。 仍未確定：關於弗林家人或父母在定罪後的資訊有限。

title.en: Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei Confirm Divorce After Over a Decade of Marriage
title.zh-TW: 方志友（Fang Zhiyou）、楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）證實離婚 11年婚姻告終

summary.en: Taiwanese celebrities Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have confirmed their divorce after 11 or 12 years of marriage. Multiple outlets report the couple issued statements ending their relationship while noting they remain family. Past comments from Fang and others about marital strains have resurfaced in coverage.
summary.zh-TW: 台灣藝人方志友（Fang Zhiyou）與楊銘威（Yang Mingwei）證實結束11或12年婚姻。多個媒體報導兩人發聲明分手，但仍視彼此為家人。方志友過往提及婚姻心結的發言也再度被提及。

body.en: Lede: Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have publicly confirmed the end of their marriage. What happened: Sources report the pair announced their divorce, with statements describing the conclusion of their long-term relationship. Coverage notes they described each other as remaining family despite the split. Reports reference an 11-year or 12-year marriage period and mention prior comments from Fang about considering ending the marriage multiple times. Why it matters: The confirmation adds to recent celebrity relationship updates in the Taiwan entertainment circle, drawing public attention to the couple's personal matters. Sources agree/disagree: Outlets consistently report the divorce confirmation and statements from the couple. Some describe the marriage length as 11 years while others reference 12 years of relationship. Still uncertain: Exact details on the timing of their separation and any specific reasons beyond general statements remain limited to the announcements covered.
body.zh-TW: 導言：方志友與楊銘威已公開證實結束婚姻。 事件經過：多個消息來源指出兩人宣布離婚，並發出聲明描述長期關係的結束。報導提及儘管分手，他們仍視彼此為家人。部分內容提到婚姻持續11年或12年，並引用方志友先前表示曾多次考慮放棄婚姻的發言。 重要性：此確認消息為台灣娛樂圈近期名人關係更新之一，引起大眾對兩人私事的關注。 來源異同：各媒體一致報導離婚確認及兩人聲明。部分描述婚姻為11年，另有提及12年感情。 尚未確定：分手確切時間及除一般聲明外的具體原因，仍僅限於已報導的公告內容。

disagreements.en: Sources differ on marriage length, with some stating 11 years and others referencing 12 years of relationship.

title.en: Ana Montana Arrested on Felony Drug Charges
title.zh-TW: 安娜·蒙塔納（Ana Montana）因重罪毒品指控被捕

summary.en: Ana Montana, identified as LaMelo Ball's baby mama with real name Analicia Chaves, was arrested Monday in Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, facing felony drug charges according to reports.
summary.zh-TW: 安娜·蒙塔納（Ana Montana），本名Analicia Chaves，被指認為拉梅洛·鮑爾（LaMelo Ball）的孩子母親，週一在北卡羅來納州梅克倫堡縣因重罪毒品指控被捕。

body.en:
Lede: NBA Star LaMelo Ball's Baby Mama Ana Montana Arrested on Felony Drug Charges.
What happened: LaMelo Ball's baby mama, Ana Montana, has found herself in some legal trouble in North Carolina. TMZ has learned she's facing felony drug charges. Montana -- real name Analicia Chaves -- was arrested Monday in Mecklenburg County.
Why it matters: The arrest involves a figure connected to a prominent NBA player, drawing attention in celebrity and sports circles.
Sources agree/disagree: Only one source covers this incident.
Still uncertain: Details beyond the arrest and charges are limited in available reports.
body.zh-TW:
導言：NBA球星拉梅洛·鮑爾（LaMelo Ball）的孩子母親安娜·蒙塔納（Ana Montana）因重罪毒品指控被捕。
事件經過：拉梅洛·鮑爾（LaMelo Ball）的孩子母親安娜·蒙塔納（Ana Montana）在北卡羅來納州陷入法律麻煩。報導指出她面臨重罪毒品指控。蒙塔納本名Analicia Chaves，週一在梅克倫堡縣被捕。
事件意義：此逮捕事件涉及與知名NBA球員相關的人物，引起名人與體育圈關注。
來源一致／分歧：僅有一來源涵蓋此事件。
仍未確定：除逮捕與指控外，可得報導細節有限。
